body:
```suggestion
	real_t radius_top = 0.5;
	real_t radius_bottom = 0.5;
	real_t height = 1.0; // Height of the cylindrical part
```

The getters/setters also need to be updated.

This is inconsistent with non-tapered capsule's height: `height = 1.0; // Height of the cylindrical part`

This needs to be updated. For the case of tapered capsules, we can rename this to `mid_height`. See https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/93836

Maybe I don't fully understand this change, but a CapsuleShape is cheaper than a TaperedCapsuleShape. So if someone is requesting a capsule shape, I would provide a capsule shape and not a tapered one.

A tapered capsule does not consist of 2 hemispheres + a surface connecting these hemispheres. You need to create less / more than half a sphere based on the radii of the top and bottom sphere. In this example, in red what the code below generates, in green what I would expect.
This bounding box is larger than needs be. In Y direction it could be `[-0.5 * mid_height - radius_bottom, 0.5 * mid_height + radius_top]`.

Hey, just thought i'd pass by and contribute : here's a [desmos graph](https://www.desmos.com/calculator/kyy1uch9xj) from the equations found in [this wikipedia page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tangent_lines_to_circles#Outer_tangent) that does what's asked above, I can modify the code to make the mesh if need be.
